description: Shows the person what Paletoo can do here: a welcome card with six example requests — a post, a whole campaign, a style battle, a brand kit from a logo, a mockup, a surprise — each with a picture of a real result, to tap and ask, and a button that opens their Paletoo. Use it when the person is new to Paletoo, asks what it can do, or says hello or help. Changes nothing and makes no design.
name: get_started
title: Get started with Paletoo
